information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

Make sure to check out [Louisiana Speedcubing's Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1025679060833637) for upcoming competitions and announcements!

- Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LouisianaMegaTwoDay2023#27726-competitor-information)  tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LouisianaMegaTwoDay2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule
